domain: Healthcare Delivery & Health Economics (payment, claims and health plan analytics)

distractor_reasons.tollard_pharmacy_rebate_statement_2025.c: the 2025 pharmacy rebates credited to the cooperative's reserve; the review memo takes plan-paid claims before rebates, so no district's figure nets them
distractor_reasons.mvshc_district_contribution_receipts_fy2: the districts' fiscal 2026 contributions billed and received; the review compares claims with the claims component of the 2026 rate, and no receipt enters it
distractor_reasons.state_school_employee_plan_survey_2025.c: a state survey's 2025 claims cost per member per month by plan type; the review rests on each district's own claims and no benchmark enters it

sources.constructed: every file is constructed for this task by its generator (task479/generator); the cooperative, the districts, the administrator, the carrier, their members and the people are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the layouts follow common third-party administrator claims lag reports, eligibility files and specific stop-loss advisories (12/15 contract basis), described in no shipped file beyond the pack's own dictionary
